footerNote: Marvell guided Q2 FY26 revenue to $2.00B ±5%.
oneTimers: On April 7, 2025 Marvell agreed to sell its automotive ethernet business to Infineon for $2.5B in cash; the business sat as $588.2M of assets held for sale on the balance sheet, and the sale closed August 14, 2025, after this quarter ended, so no gain appears here.

GAAP results include $142.1M of stock-based compensation and $245.7M of amortization of acquired intangible assets, both excluded from non-GAAP — that is why non-GAAP net income ($540.0M) is triple GAAP net income ($177.9M).
Restructuring related gains of $12.3M net this quarter — mostly a gain on selling property, partly offset by severance and facility-exit costs.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $48.7M plus a $6.0M net other loss make up the $54.7M outside operations.

takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit $1.44B — 76% of the company — up 76% YoY on custom silicon programs and electro-optics shipments, and total revenue set a record at $1.90B, up 63% YoY.
takeaways.title: Data Center drove the record

takeaways.text: GAAP net income was $177.9M versus a $215.6M loss a year ago, as operating income swung to $270.6M from a $152.3M loss. Non-GAAP net income was $540.0M.
takeaways.title: Back in the black

takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $332.9M in the quarter, and Marvell spent $340M buying back its own shares and paid $51.8M in dividends.
takeaways.title: Cash kept flowing

verdict: Marvell's revenue hit a record $1.90B, up 63% on AI data-center demand — and GAAP profit swung to $178M from a $216M loss a year ago.
